description: One season of tactica.'s forecasts against results: every finished league match we forecast, with fixtureId, league, kick-off, teams, our last forecast before kick-off (home, draw and away chances, expected goals, model version, generated time) and the final score. Our own forecasts only. Use this when you want to test or evaluate a model or strategy against our history; it may not be used to train any model or AI system. Use get_track_record instead (free) for pick results. A season without genuine pre-match forecasts returns a not-available error. Read-only. Paid: 25.00 USDC per season, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

season.description: Required. The season, four-digit start year, a hyphen and two-digit end year. Only seasons with genuine published pre-match forecasts are sold. Example: 2026-27
